description:
Speechify's mission is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, and websites into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Our products include the iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work in a distributed setting. Roles include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from companies like Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, and from leading programs and startups.

Overview

With the growth of our iOS app and recognition as Apple\'s 2025 Design Award for inclusivity, we are seeking a Senior iOS Engineer to support the growing user base and work on new projects to push the product forward. This is a key role for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys a fast-paced environment, is passionate about shaping the product, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that values leadership through technical excellence and consistent, fast delivery. Work ethic, strong communication, and a drive to win are paramount. Our interview process involves several technical interviews with a goal to complete within 1 week.

What You\'ll Do

  • Lead key engineering and product decisions
  • Actively ship production code for the Speechify iOS app
  • Work within a dedicated product team
  • Participate in product discussions to shape the product roadmap
  • Maintain and enhance the existing complex app architecture

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Experience with products scaled to a large user base
  • A track record of taking products from inception to traction and owning the engineering of the product
  • Customer obsession and a focus on providing the best possible experience
  • Product thinking to evolve the product and support internal teams and designers
  • Speed: ability to generate ideas quickly and decide what to ship now
  • Focus: ability to work in a high-growth, remote team
  • Technical skills: Swift, SwiftUI

Technical Requirements:

  • Swift programming language
  • SwiftUI experience
  • Multithreading programming
  • Working with CI/CD infrastructure
  • Experience with Fastlane
  • SOLID principles and writing well-structured classes
  • Git and understanding of different Git strategies

What We Offer:

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product
  • An entrepreneurial team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle
  • The opportunity to make a big impact in a transforming industry
  • A competitive salary and commitment to an asynchronous culture
  • Opportunity to work on a product used by millions of people and make a meaningful impact
  • Support for people with learning differences to provide reading superpowers to professionals worldwide
  • Work in a fast-growing sector: the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Audio

How to Apply

Think you\'re a good fit for this job? Tell us about yourself and why you\'re interested when you apply. Include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn. If you know someone who would be a great fit, refer them.

Construímos a Stone Tech, unindo equipes de tecnologia da Stone Co. e empresas financeiras do grupo, com inovações e tecnologias de ponta de Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta. Valorizamos um ambiente descontraído, com desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, trabalho em equipe e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossos pilares guiam o dia a dia: Own It, Live the Ride, No Bullshit, Team Play e The Reason. A experiência e a segurança do cliente são o que sustenta nosso crescimento. Como é ser uma pessoa Software Engineering Manager

O Engineering Manager II (EM II) é responsável pela liderança e gestão de uma área de médio impacto, atuando como referência técnica e de gestão de pessoas. Orienta o direcionamento tático da área, alinhando estratégia, execução, desenvolvimento de talentos e cultura de excelência, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo, colaborativo e orientado a resultados.

  • Gestão de Área e Execução Tática: construir o plano tático, coordenar execução, recursos e monitorar indicadores para alcançar objetivos estratégicos.
  • Relacionamento Interfuncional: estabelecer relações com stakeholders e áreas diversas, conduzindo conversas difíceis e fornecendo contexto dos resultados.
  • Resolução de Problemas: estruturar e solucionar problemas complexos, analisando dados e envolvendo as pessoas corretas para decisões embasadas.
  • Gestão e Desenvolvimento de Talentos: construir times de alta performance, recrutamento, feedbacks, desenvolvimento contínuo, delegação de desafios e gestão de consequências; apoiar lideranças diretas no desenvolvimento de suas equipes.
  • Cultura e Diversidade: fomentar ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e oportunidades equitativas.
  • Conhecimento do Negócio: compreender papéis, produtos, alavancas estratégicas e contexto do negócio.
  • Inovação e Aprendizado Contínuo: promover cultura de inovação, atualização tecnológica, compartilhamento de conhecimento e boas práticas do setor.

O Engineering Manager é agente de transformação, referência técnica e humana, comprometido com a excelência, diversidade, inovação e entrega de resultados sustentáveis alinhados à cultura e valores da Stone Co.

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

Join to apply for the AI Engineer - RAG Platform role at Perform

We’re hiring an AI Engineer to design and build a production-grade RAG platform that powers our test autoscripting agent. This platform ingests our QA codebase and documentation, transforms them into embeddings, and serves relevant context (page objects, fixtures, helpers, examples) via a retrieval API—enabling high-quality LLM-generated tests. You’ll own everything from ingestion to evaluation, including keeping the index fresh via Jenkins and optimizing for token cost and latency.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in the intersection of LLM tooling, backend engineering, and developer productivity.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain a local RAG platform , including:

  • Loaders for Git, Confluence, Drive.
  • Code-aware chunking (AST/semantic) and embedding pipelines.
  • Vector indexing in ChromaDB with metadata and reranking.
  • FastAPI (or similar) retrieval service for the autoscripting agent.
  • Implement metadata filters (e.g., layer=page-object|fixture|helper|test, Git SHA, feature tags) and import-based neighbor expansion to optimize context.
  • Optimize for cost and performance : tune k values, context lengths, reranker thresholds, and cache frequent retrievals.
  • Build retrieval evaluation and telemetry : track recall, faithfulness, token usage, compile success of generated code, and wire alerts into Jenkins CI.
  • Manage access to Claude 4 Sonnet and other model APIs; help deploy self-hosted endpoints if needed (keys, quotas, audit logs).
  • Write runbooks and train the SDET team on how to use and troubleshoot the RAG system.

Tech Stack (Initial Plan)

Embeddings: mxbai-embed-large-v1 (text), bge-code-base (code)

Reranker: mxbai-rerank-base-v2

Vector store: ChromaDB (local)

Pipeline orchestration: LangChain (router by MIME/type)

Retrieval API: FastAPI

Evaluation: Telemetry + basic metrics (compile/run, cost, retrieval quality)

What You Bring

  • 4+ years in ML/AI or platform-oriented backend engineering , including 2+ years building LLM
  • Development withinRAG applications .
  • Strong experience with LangChain , vector DBs (ChromaDB, Qdrant, pgvector), and code-aware embeddings (BGE-code or similar).
  • Solid Python skills (FastAPI or Flask) and comfort reading Java to inform chunking and context design.
  • Experience with Jenkins , secrets management, and basic observability tooling (Grafana, Prometheus, LangSmith, or RAGAS).
  • Comfortable working with OpenAI/Anthropic APIs or deploying self-hosted endpoints, including handling keys, rate limits, and safety controls.

It is an asset if you have:

  • Experience with Claude-specific practices , structured prompting, and cost control techniques.
  • Familiarity with retrieval evaluation tools like RAGAS or LangChain Evaluators, plus A/B testing for prompt or routing strategies.
  • Understanding of security and compliance for developer-facing AI tools (PII handling, audit logging).
  • The SDET team focuses on test quality and final review of autoscripted code.
  • The Automation Agent Engineer tunes prompts and retrieval logic.
  • You own the RAG platform : indexing, retrieval quality, LLM orchestration, and CI integration.

Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Canonical is building a team dedicated to providing security coverage across a wide range of ecosystems and environments, working to make the world a better, safer place. We are hiring an Ubuntu Security Engineer to join an industry-leading security engineering team and help protect the open source community and Ubuntu users from emerging threats. We welcome candidates across all levels of experience, from Graduate to Senior. This is an engineering-focused role that may also involve activities such as producing security assessments, building features, conducting code reviews, developing internal tools, engaging with the open source community, and participating in industry initiatives and events.   • You have a thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities and techniques for fixing them

  • You are appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • You are thoughtful and self-motivated
  • You are result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.

If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it.

We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI.

20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (React/Golang)
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply. Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About the Role

We’re looking for a driven, resourceful, and experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join one of our growing product teams. As a senior member of the team, you will be tasked with designing, building, and enhancing services and user-facing features across our platform, with a strong focus on reliability, maintainability, scalability, and user experience. You’ll leverage your expertise spanning the entire stack, from database interactions to front-end libraries, contributing significantly to our technical direction and mentoring other engineers.

How you will make an impact

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable full-stack applications and features across a modern tech stack, including Typescript, React, Go and Postgres.
  • Focus on improving our user experience, collaborating with designers to implement intuitive interfaces and finding creative ways to reduce user pain points.
  • Build and enhance microservices, focusing on reliability, maintainability, and scalability within our distributed systems.
  • Ensure the quality of our products remains high by contributing to automated testing strategies and participating actively in code reviews.
  • Collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, QA analysts, and other engineers within an Agile development framework.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices, identifying and driving improvements in our processes, architecture, and technology stack.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a collaborative environment and sharing your expertise.
  • Distill user stories or business requirements into technical requirements and robust technical designs.

You may be a good fit for this role if you

  • Are passionate about coding and creating scalable systems and fantastic user experiences.
  • Embrace a growth mindset by continuously questioning established ideas and learning from your experiences.
  • Exhibit humility and a collaborative spirit, fostering a positive work environment while valuing the contributions of others without ego.
  • Value autonomy and empowerment to make your own decisions.

What you will do

During the 1st Month :

  • Attend onboarding sessions to better understand our internal processes and learn about the company
  • Pair with other engineers to learn more about our tech stack, the products we support, and our development standards and processes
  • Familiarize yourself with our automated testing platforms and begin to contribute to our test coverage
  • Collaborate with product team members to implement and ship small features and functionality

Within 3 Months :

  • Participate in code reviews and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback to other engineers
  • Gain exposure to the platform’s underlying infrastructure and deployment processes
  • Understand the high-level architecture of the website and back-end services
  • Begin shipping more complex user-facing code

Within 6 Months :

  • Grow as a contributing member of a product team, providing input and insight to the rest of the team on challenges and feasibility of proposed development
  • Confidently implement new functionality and fix bugs across our stack
  • Work with members of the tech and product teams to distill user stories or business requirements into technical requirements / design

Within 12 months :

  • Begin identifying areas for improvement in our codebase, researching best practices, and making recommendations to the team on strategies to address them
  • Solidify understanding of the breadth of our tech stack, including underlying infrastructure, internal tools, front end applications, and how they interact with our back-end services
  • Be a subject matter expert for the product team’s areas of responsibility

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Experience with Typescript and React
  • Experience with one or more general-purpose programming languages (Go, C / C++, C#, Java, Ruby, etc.)
  • Experience with one or more SQL databases
  • Strong understanding of common data structures and design patterns
  • Experience working with a microservice architecture and distributed systems
  • Proficiency in using unit testing frameworks
  • A dedication to developing clear, reliable, and maintainable code
  • Proficiency with common git operations
  • Strong communication skills, effectively conveying ideas to both technical and non-technical partners
  • Experience mentoring other engineers

Qualifications and Experience

  • Proven experience in a Sales or Business Development role.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both verbally and written. English and Spanish are a must. Portuguese is highly desirable.
  • Military, Law enforcement and government agency experience highly desirable.
  • Experience in Government Bid & Tender processes.
  • Experience in nurturing senior executive and political level relationships.
  • Demonstrated experience achieving sales targets and generating growth.

We are a world leader in protective equipment, with a reputation for innovative design, high-performance quality and specialist materials expertise. O Ton é uma empresa do grupo Stone Co., focada em empoderar empreendedores autônomos por meio de soluções financeiras como maquininhas, conta digital, cartão e programa de renda extra. Nosso time é movido por desafios, impacto real na vida dos nossos clientes, leveza, autonomia e colaboração. Oferecemos um ambiente descontraído com horário flexível e possibilidade de trabalho remoto.

A cultura

Guiados por 5 pilares que orientam nosso dia a dia:

  • Own It : Ter espírito de dono traz autonomia e proatividade; somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e queremos evoluir o negócio.
  • Live the Ride : Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  • No Bullshit : Agir com simplicidade, ser práticos, sinceros e abertos a feedbacks para evoluirmos.
  • Team Play : “Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho; se quer ir longe, vá junto.” A colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  • The Reason : O cliente é a razão da nossa atuação; buscamos impactar positivamente a vida dele com nossas entregas.

O time de Renda Extra

A equipe do programa Renda Extra | TON está dedicada a transformar vidas por meio de oportunidades únicas de geração de renda. Nosso programa oferece uma forma inovadora para parceiros obterem renda adicional ou substituírem a renda principal, sem vínculo empregatício. Nosso objetivo é empoderar pessoas e promover estabilidade financeira e crescimento pessoal.

Como é ser uma pessoa Senior Software Engineer Node

Você terá um papel essencial na evolução do nosso ecossistema, atuando no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, provas de conceito e melhorias contínuas em microsserviços e aplicações. Contribua desde a ideação até a entrega, participe de cerimônias, revise código, mantenha e atualize a documentação técnica. Trabalhará em um time colaborativo, alinhado aos padrões técnicos da companhia, valorizando opiniões, novas ideias e iniciativas para elevar a barra técnica do produto. Espera-se compartilhar conhecimento, liderar refatorações quando necessário e participar ativamente do refinamento de demandas com o time de UX, garantindo entregas de qualidade com foco no cliente.

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência com NodeJS, TypeScript e Jest
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura moderna: SOLID, Clean Architecture, FaaS, APIs REST / WebSocket
  • Prática com AWS (Lambda, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, S3 etc.) e banco NoSQL (DynamoDB)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de cache e busca (Redis, OpenSearch / Elasticsearch)
  • Git, CI / CD, documentação técnica e segurança em desenvolvimento

O que aumenta as suas chances

  • Ensino Superior
  • Experiência com Banco de Dados relacional
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código (ex.: Terraform)
  • Habilidade de otimização para suporte de alto volume de dados
  • Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento (DataDog, CloudWatch, Splunk)
  • Experiência com automação de Testes e testes de carga (Jest, K6, JMeter)

Nossos benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação
  • Auxílio Remoto + Setup Inicial (para vagas remotas)
  • Horário flexível
  • Benefício Educação – acesso a plataforma interna (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)
  • Gympass
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte (para vagas presenciais)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Inscrição : Você começa a jornada. Analisaremos seu perfil e entraremos em contato em breve.
  • Entrevistas com o time de People
  • Avaliação Técnica : avaliação de hard skills, geralmente com dois encontros ou com desafio técnico
  • Check de Cultura : conversa com alguém da cultura para garantir alinhamento
  • Feedback : compartilharemos o retorno e próximos passos, independentemente do resultado

title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer, Recommendation Systems
description:
Overview

Lead Machine Learning Engineer, Recommendation Systems — As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers. We convert audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and continuous optimization. We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer (Recommendation Systems) to build the personalization engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

MUST HAVE

You’ve shipped large-scale ML systems into production that power personalization at scale. You’re fluent in ranking algorithms and know how to turn data into engagement and conversions. Specifically:

  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning)
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch)
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices

YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

OUTCOMES

  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability

COMPETENCIES

  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, W&B)
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity company and value diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Desenvolvedor Abap Cpi Sênior
description:
O que procuramos?

Procuramos um profissional experiente para atuar como Analista / Consultor de Integração, com foco nas tecnologias SAP ABAP e SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI). Este papel é fundamental para desenhar, desenvolver e implementar soluções de integração robustas entre os sistemas SAP e plataformas externas, garantindo a fluidez e a integridade dos dados.

Atribuições principais :

  • Desenvolvimento ABAP : Projetar e codificar programas ABAP (relatórios, módulos de função, BAPIs, BAdIs, exits, etc.) para preparar e processar dados, e garantir a comunicação eficiente com o SAP CPI.
  • Integração SAP CPI : Desenvolver e manter iFlows (Integration Flows) complexos no SAP CPI, incluindo o mapeamento de mensagens, a transformação de dados e a implementação de scripts Groovy / Java.
  • Análise e Desenho : Atuar na análise de requisitos de negócio, traduzindo-os em especificações técnicas detalhadas para as integrações.
  • Solução de Problemas : Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de integração, monitorando o fluxo de mensagens e garantindo a estabilidade das soluções.
  • Colaboração : Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes funcionais e de outras áreas para garantir que as integrações atendam às necessidades do negócio.

Requisitos :

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento SAP ABAP.
  • Conhecimento profundo em SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration), incluindo a criação de iFlows e a configuração de adaptadores (SFTP, SOAP, OData, etc.).
  • Sólido entendimento de formatos de dados como XML, JSON e EDI.
  • Experiência com APIs e serviços web (SOAP, REST).
  • Habilidade para analisar e resolver problemas de forma eficaz, com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

Diferenciais :

  • Certificação SAP em ABAP ou CPI.
  • Conhecimento de outras plataformas de integração, como SAP PI / PO.
  • Experiência com o SAP S / 4HANA.

Localidade da posição : CURITIBA - PR

Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

Quais são nossos valores?

  • Somos pessoas servindo pessoas
  • Pensamos e agimos como donos
  • Temos gana por performance
  • Crescemos e aprendemos juntos
  • Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade
  • Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

Se identificou? Então, #VemSerMeta!

title: Senior Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
Overview

Artefact Brasil is a company built on empathy with a commitment to a diverse and inclusive environment. We value every voice and encourage collaboration across ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief. We welcome incredible minds and hearts to join Artefact.

What you will be doing:

We are looking for a qualified Senior Data Scientist with Python/Pyspark experience to join our data team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data products that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end machine learning models, from data acquisition and feature engineering to production monitoring.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, product managers, and engineering teams to translate business problems into data science frameworks and ensure impactful outcomes.
  • Develop and refine complex data features from large-scale datasets to improve model accuracy and business performance.
  • Champion data quality and integrity , defining the requirements for robust datasets needed for advanced analytics and modeling.
  • Monitor, analyze, and troubleshoot the performance of deployed models, addressing issues like concept drift, data quality degradation, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Provide technical leadership in the application of statistical modeling, machine learning, and advanced analytics to solve complex business problems.
  • Document and present complex methodologies, model findings, and strategic recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Lead by example , championing a culture of scientific rigor, experimentation, and continuous learning within the data science team.
  • Mentor and coach junior data scientists and analysts, fostering their growth through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.

What we are looking for:

A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across multiple teams and levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical delivery with mentoring and team enablement.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills , with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Curiosity: You are passionate about finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You seek to understand the entire value chain and how your ML models integrate with front-end applications, back-end systems, and the underlying data infrastructure to deliver business value.
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

Required Technical Experience You have practical experience with several tools and technologies in the modern data stack, such as:

  • Programming Languages: Python for data science (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, pyspark).
    Nice to Have: Experience with a deep learning framework like PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras
  • Cloud Data Platforms: Hands-on with at least one of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, Azure, Databricks
  • Data Warehousing & Databases: Familiar with tools such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, BigQuery, Snowflake
  • Machine Learning models: Experience with supervised learning models (xgboost, logistic regression, etc) and unsupervised learning models (clustering algorithms)
  • MLOPS: Experience with at least one: Databricks, mlflow, AWS SageMaker, Vertex AI; Git code versioning workflow and platforms (GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, etc.)

What we offer:

  • Free Office – work from home or anywhere you want
  • Gympass – access to gyms and wellness programs
  • Insurance – life, health, and dental coverage
  • In-person Meetings 3x a Year – our Get Together with workshops, talks, trainings, and happy hour
  • Woba – book a coworking space wherever you like
  • Semiannual Reviews – with opportunities for promotion

Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be: come and build the future of the data field
  • Progress: every day offers new challenges and new learning opportunities
  • Culture: Empathy and Collaboration are in our DNA
  • Entrepreneurship: you will join a team of motivated entrepreneurs. We won\'t give up until we make a big difference in this industry!

title: Senior Software Engineer Node
description:
Quem é o Ton

O Ton é uma empresa do grupo Stone Co., focada em empoderar empreendedores autônomos por meio de soluções financeiras como maquininhas, conta digital, cartão e programa de renda extra. Nosso time é apaixonado por desafios e movido por impacto real na vida dos nossos clientes — sempre com leveza, autonomia e muita colaboração. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com um time de apaixonados por desafios, sempre preocupado em atender da melhor forma os nossos clientes e buscando as melhores escolhas técnicas para entregar os resultados. E mais importante, tudo isso em um ambiente descontraído com horário flexível e a possibilidade de trabalhar remoto.

Nossa cultura :

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares :

  • Own It : Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  • Live the Ride : Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  • No Bullshit : Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
  • Team Play : Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  • The Reason : O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O time de Renda Extra :

A equipe do programa Renda Extra | TON está dedicada a transformar vidas por meio de oportunidades únicas de geração de renda. Nosso programa oferece uma maneira inovadora para os nossos parceiros, de obter uma renda adicional ou até mesmo substituir sua fonte de renda principal sem nenhum vínculo empregatício. Nosso objetivo é empoderar as pessoas, proporcionando-lhes os meios para alcançar a estabilidade financeira e crescimento pessoal.

Como é ser uma pessoa SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER NODE :

Você terá um papel essencial na evolução do nosso ecossistema, atuando no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, provas de conceito e melhorias contínuas nos nossos microsserviços e aplicações. Esperamos que você contribua ativamente desde a ideação até a entrega, participando de cerimônias, revisando código, mantendo e atualizando a documentação técnica. Fará parte de um time colaborativo, engajado em criar soluções escaláveis e de alto impacto, sempre em alinhamento com os padrões técnicos da companhia. Aqui, valorizamos opiniões, ideias novas e iniciativas — queremos que você protagonize melhorias e ajude a elevar a barra técnica do produto. Também é esperado que você compartilhe conhecimento com o time, lidere refatorações quando necessário, e participe ativamente do refinamento de demandas junto ao time de UX, garantindo entregas com qualidade e foco no cliente.

O que esperamos de você :

  • Experiência com NodeJS, TypeScript e Jest
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura moderna : SOLID, Clean Architecture, FaaS, APIs REST / WebSocket
  • Prática com AWS (Lambda, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, S3 etc.) e banco NoSQL (DynamoDB)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de cache e busca (Redis, OpenSearch / ElasticSearch)
  • Git, CI / CD, documentação técnica e segurança em desenvolvimento

O que aumenta as suas chances :

  • Ensino Superior
  • Experiência Banco de Dados relacional
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de infraestrutura em código, como Terraform
  • Habilidade de otimização para suporte de alto volume de dados
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento como DataDog, CloudWatch e Splunk
  • Experiência com automação de Testes e testes de carga (Jest, K6, JMeter)

Nossos benefícios :

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Hospital Digital, da Vitta : contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática

Vale Refeição e / ou Vale Alimentação

Auxílio Remoto + Setup Inicial (exclusivo para vagas remotas)

Horário flexível

Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Gympass

Auxílio Creche

Seguro de Vida

Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo :

Inscrição : Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People : Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Avaliação Técnica : Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura : Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback : Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Observação final : Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

O Ton é uma empresa do grupo Stone Co., focada em empoderar empreendedores autônomos por meio de soluções financeiras como maquininhas, conta digital, cartão e programa de renda extra. E mais importante, tudo isso em um ambiente descontraído com horário flexível e a possibilidade de trabalhar remoto.

Nossa cultura :

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares :

Own It : Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride : Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit : Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play : Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason : O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

A equipe do programa Renda Extra | TON está dedicada a transformar vidas por meio de oportunidades únicas de geração de renda. Nosso programa oferece uma maneira inovadora para os nossos parceiros, de obter uma renda adicional ou até mesmo substituir sua fonte de renda principal sem nenhum vínculo empregatício. Nosso objetivo é empoderar as pessoas, proporcionando-lhes os meios para alcançar a estabilidade financeira e crescimento pessoal.

Como é ser uma pessoa SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER NODE :

Você terá um papel essencial na evolução do nosso ecossistema, atuando no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, provas de conceito e melhorias contínuas nos nossos microsserviços e aplicações. Fará parte de um time colaborativo, engajado em criar soluções escaláveis e de alto impacto, sempre em alinhamento com os padrões técnicos da companhia. Aqui, valorizamos opiniões, ideias novas e iniciativas — queremos que você protagonize melhorias e ajude a elevar a barra técnica do produto. Também é esperado que você compartilhe conhecimento com o time, lidere refatorações quando necessário, e participe ativamente do refinamento de demandas junto ao time de UX, garantindo entregas com qualidade e foco no cliente.

  • Prática com AWS (Lambda, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, S3 etc.) e banco NoSQL (DynamoDB)

title: Head of Cloud Curriculum
description:
About DataCamp

DataCamp's mission is to empower everyone with the data and AI skills essential for 21st-century success. By providing practical, engaging learning experiences, DataCamp equips learners and organizations of all sizes to harness the power of data and AI. As a trusted partner to over 17 million learners and 6,000+ companies , including 80% of the Fortune 1000, DataCamp is leading the charge in addressing the critical data and AI skills shortage.

About the role

As part of our mission to make data and cloud fluency accessible to all, you’ll lead a dynamic team of instructors, content creators, and technologists to craft cutting-edge courses and projects that shape the future of cloud education. Cloud technologies are transforming how businesses operate, with platforms like AWS, Azure, and GCP at the forefront. As our Head of Cloud Curriculum, you’ll be instrumental in driving this transformation, helping learners worldwide build the skills they need to succeed.

In this role, you’ll own the cloud content strategy and roadmap, working hand-in-hand with our expert instructors and the broader Cloud Curriculum team — a talented group of educators, data scientists, and technologists. Your focus will be to continuously grow and enrich our cloud content library with impactful new materials. From courses to practice pools to real-world projects, you’ll serve as a thought partner, reviewer, and passionate advocate for our learners.

With a strong technical foundation in platforms like AWS and Azure, and the ability to influence across functions, you\'ll make data-driven decisions and successfully lead complex, high-impact projects. If you have a genuine passion for cloud education and are excited to shape the next generation of cloud professionals while building the world\'s premier network of cloud instructors, this role is for you.

About you

At DataCamp, we look for individuals who embody our core values: data-driven action, transparency, ownership, and an unwavering focus on our learners. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing environment and are driven by a passion for democratizing access to data and cloud technologies.

Your entrepreneurial mindset and collaborative spirit push you beyond simply meeting targets — you’re motivated to empower learners worldwide to succeed in an increasingly cloud-first world. You\'re a true team player who enjoys working across functions: whether you\'re partnering with internal engineering, product, marketing, sales, and support teams, or rolling up your sleeves to strategize directly with clients, you bring energy and curiosity to every collaboration.

You believe that people, processes, technology, and data are the essential ingredients for digital transformation — and you\'re energized by the opportunity to help learners advance their cloud knowledge and skills. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will focus your time on the following areas:

  • Define the Vision: Set the strategy for our Cloud Curriculum roadmap (AWS, Azure, GCP, cloud engineering, DevOps, and beyond).
  • Lead and Inspire: Manage a talented team of content developers and collaborate with external experts to create best-in-class learning experiences.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Monitor industry trends and emerging cloud technologies to keep our curriculum at the forefront.
  • Drive Impact: Build engaging, practical learning paths that help learners unlock career opportunities and enable enterprise teams to scale cloud adoption.
  • Collaborate Cross-functionally: Partner closely with product, marketing, and enterprise teams to ensure our curriculum meets the evolving needs of learners and customers.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of management experience, leading teams to success.
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience in cloud platforms like AWS or Azure.
  • Proficiency in SQL and/or Python.
  • Familiarity with cloud architecture, services, and industry best practices.
  • Cloud certifications (AWS and/or Azure) are a plus but not required.
  • Passion for working collaboratively with subject matter experts and cross-functional partners.
  • Experience with interactive technical education platforms like DataCamp or similar.
  • Ability to synthesize, visualize, and clearly communicate complex ideas, including to non-technical audiences.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Comfortable challenging ideas constructively and knowing when to push back or seek compromise to drive the best outcomes for the company.

Why Datacamp?

Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you’ll love being on our team:

  • Exciting challenges: Face new technical challenges daily, keeping your work engaging and rewarding.
  • Competitive compensation: We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits.
  • Flexibility: Benefit from flexible working hours because the future is flexible!
  • Continuous learning: Access a yearly learning budget for conferences & training to support your professional growth.
  • Global retreats: Participate in international company retreats, fostering a global team spirit.
  • Equipment: Yearly refreshment of your IT Equipment budget for your home working setup.
  • Amazing team: Collaborate with a truly exceptional team—seriously, we\'re awesome!

Our competitive compensation package offers additional benefits. On top of your salary you will also receive extra legal benefits such as best-in-class medical insurance including dental and vision. Depending on your location additional benefits might be available to you.

At DataCamp, we value diverse experiences and perspectives. If you’re excited about this role but don\'t meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. We believe skills can be developed and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. Your unique talents and perspectives are what make our team great!

title: Chief Security Officer
description:
MISSIONS OF THE CHIEF SECURITY OFFICERGoal:The Country Security Officer, in full coordination with the Regional HUB Chief Security Officer, leads, coordinates, plans, implements, and organizes security-related activities for all Global Business Units and other Engie entities operating in his/her country or area of responsibility. He/she acts as the pivotal element for all security-related matters within his/her country or area, concerning both the Group and third parties collaborating with it. He/she cooperates with all interested parties and actively participates, within the framework of his/her functions, in protecting employees, infrastructures, and information against malicious acts by defining and implementing prevention and protection measures that mitigate security risks to an acceptable level.

OrganizationThe CS is appointed by the country managing director. Under the supervision of his/her manager, who may be a member of the board of directors of a GBU or Engie entity with significant security issues, the CS acts under the supervision of the Regional HUB Chief Security Officer (functional authority), to whom he/she reports directly for all security issues and logistical/financial aspects when support from the Regional HUB CSO is required. He/she must develop an annual or multi-year budget with the Regional HUB CSO to implement his/her activity plan.

He/she prepares objectives during year N for year N+1 with his/her manager, which are submitted for approval to the Regional HUB CSO, who may modify or prioritize them. Job description:Advise the country managing director and managers of GBUs or other Engie entities on security issues. Ensure deployment of the Group's security policy in his/her country and alignment of his/her security action plan with this policy and Group guidelines.

Maintain and develop liaison with all local Engie personnel, local administrations, and government/military agencies as necessary. Participate in bi-monthly security gatherings, transmit information to the Regional HUB CSO, and report notable events. Identify, monitor, and respond to threats to employees, assets, and facilities, providing alerts on immediate threats and emerging trends.

Monitor local regulations, technologies, threats, contribute to threat watches, and facilitate exchanges with relevant units. Implement physical protection measures (badges, cameras, alarms, locks) to ensure a secure environment for employees, including travel advisories for business travelers. Participate in protecting sensitive information, raise staff awareness, and contribute to information classification and investigation of leaks.

Prepare for security crises and participate in crisis management as needed. Participate in annual internal control exercises, identify gaps, and develop risk mitigation plans. Manage security aspects of major Group events, collaborating with the Regional HUB CSO as necessary.

Develop country-specific security policies, procedures, and plans in conjunction with the Regional HUB CSO, ensuring compliance with security rules and regulations. Conduct audits and due diligence on third-party security providers and subcontractors, sharing results with the Regional HUB CSO and DSIE.Collaborate with business developers to identify project-related risks.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role will interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

Technical Expertise

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency : Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI / CD : Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design : Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.
  • NET Development Skills : Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework.   • Security and Compliance : Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.

Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.

How your day will look like / Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends

Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships

Knowledge

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors

Skills

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)

Attitude

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Açougueiro - Comendador Soares
description:
Descrição Do Trabalho

Atender ao cliente conforme solicitação, observando as normas relativas à fiscalização sanitária e relativas à medicina ocupacional do trabalho, dentre as estabelecidas na presente instrução.

  • Atender os clientes com atenção, educação, cordialidade e presteza.
  • Selecionar o corte escolhido pelo cliente atenendo às especificações de marca, quantidade e qualidade do produto.
  • Servir o cliente conforme solicitação, seguindo os padrões de corte conhecidos no mercado, buscando a plena satisfação do cliente e observando o método de trabalho da empresa.
  • Manter o balcão de carnes limpo, higienizado, organizado, arrumado e cheio de produto.
  • Preparar as receitas conforme manual.
  • Manter a câmara frigorífica limpa, higienizada e arrumada, assegurando a retirada de mercadorias vencidas.
  • Manter o estoque arrumado e com as validades mais antigas saindo primeiro.
  • Informar ao encarregado direto qualquer problema com produtos do setor e/ou com clientes insatisfeitos.
  • Verificar diariamente a validade de todos os produtos que fazem parte da seção, retirando imediatamente os que se encontram para vencer no prazo de 30 dias e informando ao superior as condições do produto.
  • Solicitar autorização ao superior hierárquico para desprezar produtos que se encontram fora da validade e/ou que estejam em condições inadequadas ao consumo, retirando-os da área de venda e armazenagem imediatamente de forma devida e orientada.
  • Usar EPI, especialmente na câmara fria, para organização e arrumação, obrigatoriamente a luva de malha de aço para fins de corte de carne, sendo proibido o exercício da atribuição sem o equipamento necessário.
  • Permanecer apenas o tempo necessário em ambientes prejudiciais à saúde, condicionada ao uso do equipamento individual indicado pelo serviço de medicina ocupacional, sendo terminantemente proibido o ingresso nas câmaras frias sem o equipamento de proteção individual necessário.
  • Zelar pela apresentação pessoal e utilizar uniforme limpo e conservado.
  • Manter as botas e o avental limpos e higienizados.
  • Usar cabelo e unhas cortados.
  • A utilização de touca é obrigatória no setor e faz parte do uniforme.
  • Utilizar máscara protetora.
  • É proibido o uso de barba e bigode por questões de fiscalização sanitária.
  • É proibido o uso de acessórios (brincos, pulseiras, relógios e outros) por questões de segurança do trabalho, pois podem ocasionar acidentes.
  • É obrigatório o uso de luvas descartáveis para manipulação dos produtos e para atendimento ao cliente.
